expectation: Cytoplasmic/filamentous VIM in mesenchymal cells (fibroblasts, endothelium, smooth muscle) and some immune cells: stromal cells in the lamina propria, around vessels and in the submucosa and muscularis. Epithelium should be negative. Common in stroma, scattered single cells in the mucosa.
observed: A: yellow signal fills the stromal and submucosal tissue between the epithelial folds and outlines the outer layer. The epithelium is dim blue with little yellow. B and C: scattered single yellow cells with ring or filament shapes in the lamina propria, and a clump at the top of B. C shows a ring of cells under the crypt epithelium. D: bright cells with cytoplasmic fibrous outlines, plus one saturated blob.
why: Signal is confined to stromal and subepithelial cells with cytoplasmic outlines and spares the epithelium, as vimentin should.
